name: Kimi ga Shine -Tasuuketsu Death Game-
original_name: キミガシネ　―多数決デスゲーム―
source:
Sara Chidouin returns home from school late one night to discover that something's gone terribly wrong.
When she comes to, she finds herself, her friend Joe, and 9 other people trapped in a mysterious place.
Placed in life-and-death situations, they must come to an agreement about what they should do - and who should die.

[From [url=https://vgperson.com/games/yourturntodie.htm]vgperson[/url]]
translation:
一天深夜，萨拉·奇杜因 (Sara Chidouin) 从学校回到家，发现事情出了严重问题。
当她醒来时，发现自己、她的朋友乔和其他9个人被困在一个神秘的地方。
处于生死攸关的情况下，他们必须就自己应该做什么以及谁应该死达成一致。

[来自[url=https://vgperson.com/games/yourturntodie.htm]vgperson[/url]]
